submission.justification: Algorithm-L3 is recommended with a threshold of 35 GeV. This configuration achieves 85% signal efficiency at the allocated 8 kHz trigger rate, exceeding the minimum 80% requirement by a comfortable margin. The algorithm's latency of 3.1 μs is well within the hard 4.0 μs constraint, providing a 0.9 μs safety margin for hardware variations. Algorithm-L2 was disqualified due to its 5.8 μs latency exceeding the buffer limit. While Algorithm-L1 has lower latency (1.9 μs), Algorithm-L3's sophistication advantage enables it to achieve higher signal efficiency at the same trigger rate, which directly addresses the goal of maximizing signal efficiency. The 35 GeV threshold balances signal acceptance against background rejection to meet the rate allocation.
